# Experiences (English)

## Coffee Region classics

### Coffee farm visit

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/coffee-farm-visit.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Colombian coffee has a Designation of Origin, and the Coffee Cultural Landscape is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. On a traditional farm you follow the process from seed to cup and learn how to taste coffee: the essential Coffee Region experience.

Includes: Transport; Hosts at the farm; Cupping and brewing methods; Coffee tasting; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Don't wear perfume or scented creams. Ideal for ages 4 to 80.

### Filandia Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/filandia-tour.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Filandia is one of the best-preserved towns in the Coffee Cultural Landscape: colourful balconies, bahareque (wattle-and-daub) architecture and a basket-weaving tradition that is still alive.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Visit to the basket-weaving centre; Coffee tasting; Digital photos.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes and bring a rain jacket. Ideal for ages 4 to 80. Optional: basket-weaving workshop (extra cost).

### Cocora Valley & Salento Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/cocora-valley-salento-tour.html
Duration: 7 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

The Cocora Valley, with the wax palm, Colombia's national tree, is the country's most recognised image, and Salento is the oldest municipality in Quindío. Together they are the essential tour on any trip to the Coffee Region.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Hike; Coffee tasting; Lunch; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, sunscreen, a cap, and comfortable clothes and shoes. Best Monday to Friday, as the destination has limited visitor capacity. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

### Cocora Valley and Salento – Shared Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/shared-tour-cocora-valley-salento.html
Duration: 7 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: From 8:00 AM

Departure at 8:15 a.m. from Armenia to the Cocora Valley, with interpretation of the cloud forest and the wax palm. The guide leads the walk at the Bosque de Palmas viewpoint (about 2 to 3 h). Then we head back to Salento for a historical tour, time for lunch, a stroll along the Calle Real, shopping time and a coffee tasting. Return to Armenia around 3:30 p.m.

Includes: Transport; Guided tour in Spanish; Visit to the Cocora Valley; Entrance to the Bosque de Palmas viewpoint; Visit to Salento and the Calle Real; Specialty coffee tasting; Assistance card.
Tips: Every day From 2 passengers

### Coffee Farm Visit – Shared Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/shared-tour-coffee-farm.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: From 8:00 AM

Departure at 8:00 a.m. from Armenia to a coffee farm. The tour starts at the coffee seedbeds, where visitors discover the secrets of cultivation. Walking through the coffee plantations, they learn about the varieties while hearing stories of a traditional farm. The experience includes the wet-milling and drying process and ends with a workshop to tell apart and enjoy the unique nuances of this iconic drink.

Includes: Transport; Guided tour in Spanish by the coffee farm host; Coffee tasting; Assistance card.
Tips: Monday to Sunday From 2 passengers At the farm from 9:00 a.m. to about 11:30 a.m.

### Mountain Towns of the Cordillera – Shared Tour: Córdoba, Pijao and Buenavista

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/shared-tour-cordillera-cordoba-pijao-and-buenavista.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: From 8:00 AM

Meeting in Armenia at 8:00 a.m. to start a tour of southern Quindío. We visit Córdoba, known for the use and preservation of guadua bamboo. We continue to Pijao, a Cittaslow town, where we walk its streets and hear local stories. We end in Buenavista, Quindío's viewpoint par excellence, with views ideal for photos and a tasting of an exquisite high-altitude coffee. A natural and cultural experience that combines landscape and local traditions.

Includes: Transport; Guided tour in Spanish; Visit to Córdoba, Pijao and Buenavista; Craft workshop or demonstration; Specialty coffee tasting at the San Alberto terrace; Assistance card.
Tips: Every day From 2 passengers

### Full Day Mountain Towns of the Cordillera: Córdoba, Pijao & Buenavista

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/full-day-mountain-towns-of-the-cordillera-cordoba-pijao-buenavista.html
Duration: 8 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

The lesser-known Quindío: a day in the mountains, travelling along rural roads to discover the authentic character of three towns in the cordillera.

Includes: Transport; Willys jeep ride (conditions permitting); Guide; Coffee tasting; Souvenir; Lunch; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 80. You can add a visit to a coffee farm (extra cost).

### Full Day Filandia, Cocora Valley & Salento

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/full-day-filandia-cocora-valley-salento.html
Duration: 8 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

Quindío's three must-sees in a single day: the wax palms of Cocora, Salento's Calle Real and the basketry of Filandia, with lunch included. Ideal if you are short of time and want the essentials.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Basket-weaving culture; Entrance to a viewpoint in Cocora; Coffee tasting; Souvenir; Lunch; Hydration; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Best Monday to Friday, as the destination has limited visitor capacity. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

## Nature and birdwatching

### Wax palms in the high Andean forest (Pijao)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/wax-palms-in-the-high-andean-forest.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 7:00 AM and 9:00 AM

The wax palm is Colombia's national tree and the tallest palm in the world. This route, by Willys and on foot through the cloud forest of Pijao, lets you see it in its natural habitat, away from the crowds.

Includes: Transport; Willys jeep ride; Hydration; Guide; Contribution to the local community; Country-style packed lunch; Digital photos.
Tips: Wear trekking clothes: comfortable, waterproof and long-sleeved. Moderate difficulty: you climb between 2,200 and 2,600 m above sea level. Ideal for ages 12 to 70. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Birdwatching and bird photography for enthusiasts

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birdwatching-or-bird-photography-for-enthusiasts.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Start between 5:00 AM and 6:00 AM

Colombia has more bird species than any other country on the planet, and the Coffee Region is one of its best destinations. With an expert guide and binoculars, even if you have never done it before, you get to see and photograph species such as the Andean Motmot, the Emerald Toucanet and tanagers.

Includes: Transport; Breakfast; Birding guide; Binoculars; Bird checklist; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent and comfortable long-sleeved clothes in earth tones. Departure between 5:00 and 6:00 a.m. Ideal for ages 12 to 70. The tour takes place in a nature reserve near your hotel.

### Birding for experts (specialised birdwatching)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birding-for-experts-specialised-birdwatching.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca

For experienced birders: days out at the best birding spots in the Coffee Cultural Landscape, where eBird records between 170 and 370 species per site. The specialist guide plans the route around the species your group is looking for.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent and water; on high-mountain routes, thermal clothing. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Nature reserves · Barbas-Bremen

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/nature-reserves-barbas-bremen.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío

Between Filandia and Pereira, Barbas-Bremen is one of the last corridors of Andean forest in the region and home to howler monkeys: the ideal place to hear and see them in the wild, along trails through forest and guadua bamboo.
Tips: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes. Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness. Ideal for ages 12 to 70. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Nature reserves · Otún Quimbaya

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/nature-reserves-otun-quimbaya.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Risaralda

A National Natural Parks Fauna and Flora Sanctuary in the Otún River basin: a refuge for the Cauca Guan, a bird endemic to Colombia, and for howler monkeys, less than an hour from Pereira.
Tips: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes. Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness. Ideal for ages 12 to 70. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Nature reserves · Río Blanco

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/nature-reserves-rio-blanco.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Caldas

Just minutes from Manizales, the Río Blanco Reserve protects the city's water and is one of Colombia's best-known birding destinations, famous for its antpitta feeders, which draw birdwatchers from all over the world.
Tips: Bring insect repellent and comfortable, waterproof, long-sleeved clothes. Low, moderate or moderate-to-high difficulty, depending on the group's fitness. Ideal for ages 12 to 70. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Night experience: frogs and amphibians

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/night-experience-frogs-and-amphibians.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío, Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Pickup at 6:00 PM

At night, with a biologist specialising in herpetology, discover glass frogs, chocolate-brown frogs and poison frogs in the forest streams.

Includes: Transport; Herpetologist guide; Equipment; Souvenir; Light dinner; Entrance to the reserve; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a change of clothes, a waterproof and long sleeves. When booking, send each person's shoe or boot size. Moderate difficulty: you walk over mountain terrain, through streams or rivers. Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for people with knee or hip injuries.

### A World of Orchids

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/a-world-of-orchids.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

With an orchid specialist, tour the nursery and the “crèche” for baby orchids, take part in a conservation planting and learn how to care for orchids at home.

Includes: Transport; Orchid specialist; Planting activity; Souvenir; Entrance to the reserve; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 5 to 80. Not suitable for people allergic to pollen or insect stings.

### Cocora Valley Trek: Acaime, home of the hummingbirds

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/cocora-valley-trek-acaime-home-of-the-hummingbirds.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM

The Cocora Valley is Colombia's most iconic landscape, with the largest concentration of wax palms in the country. This trek goes beyond the viewpoint: it crosses suspension bridges and cloud forest to Acaime, where dozens of hummingbirds come within centimetres of you.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Hydration; Snack; Souvenir; Entrance to the reserve; Digital photos.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved trekking clothes in earth tones, and bring insect repellent and a waterproof jacket. Moderate difficulty. Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### La Carbonera, Wax Palm Sanctuary

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/la-carbonera-wax-palm-sanctuary.html
Duration: 8 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 6:00 AM and 7:00 AM

La Carbonera is home to one of the largest and best-preserved wax palm populations in the world, on the border between Quindío and Tolima and away from the crowds of Cocora. You reach it along the old Camino Nacional, at 3,370 m above sea level.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Hydration; Brunch; Medical insurance; Digital photos.
Tips: Wear trekking gear: shoes with good grip, comfortable waterproof clothes and a warm layer. Moderate-to-high difficulty; maximum altitude: 3,370 m above sea level. Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Páramo hiking: a unique ecosystem (Pijao)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/paramo-hiking-a-unique-ecosystem.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 6:00 AM and 8:00 AM

Colombia has around half of the world's páramos, the “water factories” of the Andes. Walk among frailejón plants in the Páramo del Chilí, up to 3,800 m above sea level.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Hydration; Packed lunch; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring thermal and waterproof clothing, shoes with good grip, energy snacks and plenty of water. Moderate-to-high difficulty; maximum altitude: 3,800 m above sea level. Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions.

### Visit to La Romelia · orchids and exotic fruits

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/visit-to-la-romelia-orchids-and-exotic-fruits.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Caldas

A farm near Manizales devoted to orchids, bonsai and fruit trees: tour the nurseries with a guide, visit the main house and taste fruit from the farm, with a traditional country lunch included.
Tips: Bring comfortable clothes, closed-toe shoes, a cap, sunscreen, insect repellent and a light waterproof. Not suitable for people allergic to flowers or pollen. Minimum 4 people.

### Birds · Rancho California (waterbirds)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-rancho-california-waterbirds.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

A wetland in the Barragán River valley and a refuge for waterbirds: a flat, easy route through pastures, lakes and rivers, ideal for the first day of your trip.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent, water, a cap and sunscreen: it gets hot at midday. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Camino Nacional (Humboldt's route)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-camino-nacional-humboldt-s-route.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

The old trail travelled by Humboldt and Bonpland in 1801, through cloud forest at 3,370 m above sea level. It is one of the best places in the country to see the Yellow-eared Parrot, which nests in the wax palm and was on the brink of extinction.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent, water, a warm layer and thermal clothing: it is cold early in the morning. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Bremen–La Popa (Barbas-Bremen IBA)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-bremen-la-popa-barbas-bremen-iba.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

A protected area and Important Bird Area (IBA) in the Barbas River canyon, with a walk along a wide, flat track and frequent birdwatching stops.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent and water. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Bird garden in Circasia

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-bird-garden-in-circasia.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

Watch and photograph birds from the covered terrace of a house whose gardens border the forest, with specialty coffee: no physical effort, and sheltered from sun and rain. Ideal for people with reduced mobility and for photographers.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes in neutral tones; if you have a camera or binoculars, bring them. Suitable for people with reduced mobility. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Caicedonia and Sevilla (Valle del Cauca)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-caicedonia-and-sevilla-valle-del-cauca.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Norte del Valle del Cauca

Caicedonia, the “Sentinel of the Valley”, is home to more than 325 bird species among coffee plantations, lakes and wetlands. Short routes with a local guide who is among the leading birdwatchers in Valle del Cauca.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent and water. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Retorno del Colibrí (feeders and photography)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-retorno-del-colibri-feeders-and-photography.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Tolima

A reserve dedicated to conservation, with gardens and feeders designed for photographing hummingbirds and endemic birds at close range. The activity is almost entirely stationary: a nature photographer's dream.
Tips: Departs from Quindío. Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Bring insect repellent and water. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

### Birds · Alto del Campanario (páramo)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/birds-alto-del-campanario-paramo.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

Páramo and high Andean forest birds between 3,400 and 4,600 m above sea level: mixed flocks, tapaculos, antpittas and high-altitude tanagers in a landscape of mist and frailejón plants. For birders in good physical condition.
Tips: Wear long-sleeved, waterproof clothes in greens, browns or olive (no white or bright colours) and hiking boots. Bring thermal clothing, gloves and a warm hat, and plenty of water. If you have binoculars or a camera, bring them. Not suitable for people with a history of heart or respiratory conditions. Minimum 2 people; large groups are split up.

## Rural and community experiences

### Cacao Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/cacao-tour.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

Colombia is recognised around the world for its fine cacao, prized for its flavour and aroma. Take part in the process from pod to drink, alongside the families who grow it: a side of the Coffee Region that few people know.

Includes: Transport; Snack; Hosts at the farm; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 80. The tour visits farms near your hotel; transport may be by tourist vehicle or Jeep Willys, depending on road conditions.

### Fruit Tour (pineapple, guava or citrus)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/fruit-tour-the-guava-experience.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

Quindío is a true fruit basket: tour the farm starting at the seedbed, harvest the fruit with your own hands and transform it in a hands-on workshop. Ideal for families and for seeing the countryside beyond coffee.

Includes: Transport; Tasting; Hosts at the farm; Preparation workshop; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 80. You visit an estate that grows pineapple, guava or citrus, depending on the season; transport may be by tourist vehicle or Jeep Willys, depending on road conditions.

### Sugarcane & Trapiche Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/sugarcane-trapiche-tour.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

Panela (unrefined cane sugar) is a symbol of the Colombian table. Watch the sugar mill (trapiche) at work, from cutting the cane to the finished block of panela, and spend time with the farmers who keep this craft alive.

Includes: Transport; Tasting; Hosts at the farm; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 80. At weekends you see the full production process; on weekdays, part of it.

### Bee Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/bee-tour.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Wearing a beekeeper's suit, step into the apiary and learn from a local family how artisanal honey is harvested and why bees are key to coffee and the region's other crops.

Includes: Transport; Tastings; Beekeeping equipment; Local beekeeper hosts; Souvenir; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable long-sleeved clothes and hiking boots. Don't wear perfume or scented creams. When booking, send each participant's size for the beekeeping suit. Ideal for ages 10 to 60. Not suitable for people allergic to insect or bee stings.

### Hands-on tour: Farmer for a Day

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/hands-on-tour-farmer-for-a-day.html
Duration: 8 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

The most authentic way to experience the Coffee Cultural Landscape, a UNESCO World Heritage Site: join the daily routine of a farming family (picking coffee, fruit and plantain, looking after the animals) and share their table.

Includes: Transport; Snack; Lunch; Local hosts; Taking part in farm chores; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring long-sleeved clothes and hiking boots. Don't wear perfume or scented creams.

### Plantain Tour · local delicacies (Pueblo Tapao)

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/plantain-tour-local-delicacies.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

Quindío is one of the country's leading plantain producers. In Pueblo Tapao, the community shows you its plantain varieties, how they are grown and its recipes, and you taste dishes you won't find in a restaurant.

Includes: Transport; Tastings; Local hosts; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 80.

### Artisans · Making Jeep Willys

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/artisans-making-jeep-willys.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca

The Jeep Willys, the “Yipao”, is the symbol of Quindío and part of the region's cultural heritage. In this workshop you assemble your own miniature Willys and take home an icon of the Coffee Cultural Landscape.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 5 to 80. We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

### Artisans · Making birds

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/artisans-making-birds.html
Duration: 1.5 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca

A workshop with an association of women heads of household from Armenia who created their own modelling paste for making birds. Mould and paint a bird from the region while they tell you how to recognise it in the countryside, and take your piece home as a keepsake.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 5 to 80. We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

### Artisans · Balconies

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/artisans-balconies.html
Duration: 1.5 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca

The colourful balconies and bahareque (wattle-and-daub) architecture are part of what UNESCO recognised in the Coffee Cultural Landscape. In this workshop you recreate a typical balcony in miniature and take home a piece of that architecture.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 5 to 80. We come to you: it can be done at your hotel or wherever you are.

### Artisans · Clay

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/artisans-clay.html
Duration: 1.5 h · Where: Quindío

Local artisans teach you to work the clay they gather from the rivers of the cordillera. Mould your own piece while you listen to stories of the craft: they collect around a thousand pieces before lighting the kiln, where the pieces are fired for up to 24 hours.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 5 to 80.

### Artisans · Basket-weaving workshop

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/artisans-basket-weaving-workshop.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío

Filandia is known for its basket-weaving tradition, a craft handed down from generation to generation using vines and fibres from the region. Weave your own piece with a master artisan and get to know a living tradition of the Coffee Cultural Landscape first-hand.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 5 to 80.

### Local beer tasting

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/local-beer-tasting.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío

A tasting led by the brewmaster of a craft brewery: a tour of the brewery, the styles and processes, food pairing and a souvenir. Learn to recognise the aroma, colour and flavour of each beer.
Tips: Bring comfortable shoes, insect repellent and sunscreen. Let us know in advance if you have any dietary restrictions. For over-18s only.

### Cacao Farm Visit – Shared Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/shared-tour-cacao.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: From 8:00 AM

Departure at 8:00 a.m. from Armenia to a cacao farm. Along the way you explore the crops and learn the process from harvest to the making of cacao products. Visitors take part in the process and enjoy preparing and tasting a traditional drink. An authentic and unforgettable experience.

Includes: Transport; Guided tour in Spanish by the cacao farm host; Chocolate and traditional baked goods tasting; Assistance card.
Tips: Every day From 2 passengers At the farm from 9:15 a.m. to about 12:00 noon

## Adventure

### Horse-riding experience: river and mountain

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/horseback-riding-experience-river-and-mountain.html
Duration: 2.5 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM

A ride with a purpose: the horses are rescued and rehabilitated, and the former cattle ranch is now a nature reserve that has recovered its forest. You cross guadua bamboo groves, grasslands and rivers with local cowboys and finish with lunch at the ranch house.

Includes: Transport; Horse-handling briefing; Accompanied by cowboys; Hearty snack; Protective gear (helmet); Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat and trekking shoes (they may get wet). Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems.

### Deluxe horse ride in the cordillera

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/deluxe-horseback-ride-in-the-cordillera.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

A premium ride on Arabian and Spanish horses through the cordillera, with a training demonstration, the planting of a native tree, a luxury picnic and a return by Willys with a mountain-style lunch.

Includes: Transport; Horse-handling briefing; Accompanied by cowboys; Protective gear (helmet); Luxury picnic and country-style lunch; Fruit tasting and hydration; Planting activity; Willys jeep experience; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes and a hat or cap. Ideal for ages 12 to 60. Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems. Certified under the NTS AV 014 standard (horse riding in adventure tourism) and for good equine practices.

### Paragliding

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/paragliding.html
Duration: 1 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 7:00 AM or 10:00 AM

See the Coffee Cultural Landscape from the air: a flight with certified pilots over mountains, coffee plantations and valleys, with video and photos included.

Includes: Transport; Activity with certified pilots; 3-min video and 25 photos.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes, lace-up shoes and sunglasses, and bring a warm layer. The flight lasts 15 to 20 minutes, depending on the weather. Ideal for ages 4 to 65. Not suitable for people who have had recent surgery, pregnant women or anyone under the influence of alcohol or other substances.

### Paratrike

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/paratrike.html
Duration: 1 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 7:00 AM or 10:00 AM

Motorised paragliding suitable for people with reduced mobility: a 360° view over Quindío and Valle del Cauca. An inclusive adventure, with video and photos.

Includes: Transport; Activity with certified pilots; 3-min video and 25 photos.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes, lace-up shoes and sunglasses, and bring a warm layer. Suitable for people with reduced mobility. The flight lasts 15 to 20 minutes, depending on the weather. Ideal for ages 4 to 65. Not suitable for people who have had recent surgery, pregnant women or anyone under the influence of alcohol or other substances.

### Canopy adventure in nature

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/canopy-adventure-in-nature.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío, Norte del Valle del Cauca

Zip wires over the treetops, about 15 minutes from Armenia, with views of the coffee landscape. Suitable for families and first-timers, with equipment and safety protocols for every level.
Tips: Wear closed-toe lace-up shoes and comfortable clothes (long trousers), with nothing loose in your pockets. Weather-dependent: it does not run if it rains.

## Theme parks

### Parque del Café

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/parque-del-cafe.html
Duration: 7 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

The Coffee Region's most emblematic theme park: coffee culture told through shows, a coffee trail, a funicular, a cable car and fairground rides. An ideal outing for families and groups.

Includes: Transport; Pasaporte Múltiple (park pass).
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. “Pasaporte Múltiple”: height over 124 cm; “Junior”: children from 90 to 124 cm; “Senior”: over-70s. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 70.

### PANACA

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/panaca.html
Duration: 7 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

The park of farming culture, built on the idea that “without the countryside, there is no city”: a route of more than 2.5 km with farm-animal stations and shows featuring horses, dogs and pigs. Very popular with families and schoolchildren.

Includes: Transport; Pasaporte Terra (park pass).
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Children under 90 cm go free. Travesía night show: Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays at 6:00 p.m. (extra cost). Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

### RECUCA Coffee Culture Tour

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/recuca-coffee-culture-tour.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

Dress up as a coffee picker and live the coffee cycle like a traditional grower: pick, pulp, dry, hull, roast and grind. A hands-on experience from seed to cup.

Includes: Transport; Entrance.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Tours and tastings every half hour, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Children under 90 cm go free. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

### Parque Los Arrieros

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/parque-de-los-arrieros.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

A tribute to arriería (mule driving), the trade that settled and built the region: 8 artistic performances and 14 interactive activities to understand the history of the Coffee Region in a fun way.

Includes: Transport; Entrance.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Arrive before 10:00 a.m. so you don't miss any of the performances. Children under 90 cm go free. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

### Bioparque Ukumarí

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/bioparque-ukumari.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Risaralda · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

One of the largest bioparks in Latin America, dedicated to conservation: spectacled bears, pumas, Andean birds and an African savannah with giraffes, lions and rhinos.

Includes: Transport; Entrance.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturdays, 8:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Guided tours: 10:00, 10:30 and 11:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 65.

### Quindío Botanical Garden & Butterfly House

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/quindio-botanical-garden-butterfly-house.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM

A research and conservation centre for the native flora and fauna of Quindío, with the National Palm Collection, the largest palm collection in Colombia, and a butterfly house where you walk among butterflies.

Includes: Transport; Entrance.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable long-sleeved clothes in earth tones, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Last entry: 3:30 p.m. English-speaking guide at extra cost. Ideal for families, ages 4 to 75.

### Laberinto Mil Caminos

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/laberinto-mil-caminos.html
Duration: 3 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM

One of the largest mazes in Latin America: more than 3 km of paths among 24,000 shrubs, in a space to contemplate, play and switch off.

Includes: Transport; Entrance.
Tips: Bring insect repellent, comfortable clothes, a hat or cap and sunscreen. Open Tuesday to Sunday and on public holidays, from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (last entry). Ideal for families, ages 4 to 75.

## Cities

### City tour of Pereira

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/city-tour-of-pereira.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Risaralda · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Pereira, the “Pearl of the Otún”, is the most dynamic city in the Coffee Region: the cathedral, the Plaza de Bolívar with Arenas Betancourt's Bolívar Desnudo (“Naked Bolívar”) and the César Gaviria Viaduct, rounded off with specialty coffee.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Specialty coffee tasting; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

### City tour of Manizales

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/city-tour-of-manizales.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Caldas · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Manizales, built on mountainsides and overlooking the Nevado del Ruiz, has one of the tallest cathedrals in Latin America, which you can climb via the Polish Corridor. Includes the cable car, the historic centre and coffee at a viewpoint.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Entrance to the Cathedral's Corredor Polaco; Visit to a viewpoint; Specialty coffee tasting; Cable car ticket; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

### Traditional city tour of Armenia

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/traditional-city-tour-of-armenia.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Armenia, the “Miracle City”, was rebuilt after the 1999 earthquake. The tour includes the Quimbaya Gold Museum, designed by the architect Rogelio Salmona, with one of the most important collections of pre-Columbian goldwork in the country.

Includes: Transport; Guide; Entrance to Parque de la Vida; Visit to the Museo del Oro Quimbaya; Specialty coffee tasting; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

### City tour: Cuyabro art and single-origin coffee

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/cuyabro-art-and-single-origin-coffee.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Quindío · Schedule: Pickup: 9:00 AM or 2:00 PM

Armenia told through its street art: murals, graffiti and barranquismo, a sculptural technique born in the region, with works by the artist Henry Villada. It ends with a tasting of single-origin coffees.

Includes: Transport; Interpretive guide; Single-origin coffee tasting; Digital photos.
Tips: Insect repellent and comfortable clothes are recommended. Ideal for ages 4 to 70.

### Community tour in Cartago

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/community-tour-in-cartago.html
Duration: 6 h · Where: Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Pickup at 9:00 AM

Cartago is Colombia's embroidery capital. With young people and women from Comuna 1, you visit the cathedral and churches, enjoy an embroidery Graffitour and learn the basic techniques in a home workshop, where you embroider your own design.

Includes: Transport; Snack; Guide; Craft workshop; Lunch; The craft piece you make; Digital photos.
Tips: Wear comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 6 to 80.

## Wellness

### Hot springs: Santa Rosa, San Vicente or El Otoño

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/hot-springs-santa-rosa-san-vicente-el-otono-or-tierra-viva.html
Duration: 4 h · Where: Risaralda, Caldas · Schedule: Start between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM

The hot springs of the Coffee Region are fed by the volcanic activity of the Central Cordillera and emerge at around 70 °C. Surrounded by waterfalls and forest, they are the perfect way to rest after your hikes.

Includes: Transport; Hydration; Entrance to the selected hot springs reserve; Digital photos.
Tips: Bring a swimsuit, a towel, insect repellent and comfortable clothes. Ideal for ages 6 to 80. Not recommended for people with a history of heart conditions. At weekends and in high season, check opening times.

## Groups and premium

### Specialty coffee cupping

Page: https://www.espontaneostravel.com/en/experiences/specialty-coffee-cupping.html
Duration: 2 h · Where: Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Norte del Valle del Cauca · Schedule: Start between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM

From bean to cup: learn to identify the citrus, chocolatey or spicy notes of specialty coffee, the product that made the region famous around the world.

Includes: Transport; Cupping activity; Coffee tastings; Digital photos.
Tips: It can be done at your hotel or wherever you are. Ideal for ages 18 to 80.

# Frequently asked questions
### Who is Espontáneos Travel?
Hi! We're Espontáneos Travel, a tour operator in the Coffee Cultural Landscape with more than 15 years of experience. We specialise in rural, nature, community and wellness experiences. Our purpose is to connect you authentically and responsibly with the nature and culture of our region.

### How do I book and what do I need?
It's very easy! To confirm your booking we need the full names and ID documents of the passengers, along with proof of payment of the deposit. Once we receive them, we'll send you the formal confirmation of your trip.

### How much do the experiences cost?
The price depends on the number of people and where you're staying. Tell me how many people and the date, and I'll send you a quote.

### Do I pay everything upfront? Which payment methods do you accept?
To book, you pay a 50% deposit. Your quote shows the balance due and the payment deadlines.
Payment methods, in the name of Espontáneos Travel SAS (NIT 902.056.513):
Bancolombia savings: 756-000062-16
Nequi or Daviplata: +57 317 645 6723
Debit or credit card: secure Wompi payment button
You can pay the balance in Colombian pesos, US dollars or euros.
Send us the receipt on WhatsApp.
We only use these methods. If anyone asks you to pay into another account, check with us first.

### Do you offer airport transfers?
We provide transfers from El Edén (Armenia) and Matecaña (Pereira) airports to hotels in Quindío and Risaralda, and between Armenia, Pereira and Manizales. The journey takes approx. 1 h.

### What should I bring?
To make the most of the Coffee Cultural Landscape, bring very comfortable clothes, sunscreen and insect repellent, stay well hydrated and keep your ID document handy.

### What's the weather like?
Mild climate all year round; it can rain in any season. It gets cold in Cocora, in the páramo and among the wax palms.

### When is high season?
High season 2026: Holy Week (28 Mar–5 Apr), school break (3–12 Oct) and the year-end holidays (19 Dec 2026–11 Jan 2027). Prices and availability vary.

### Is it suitable for children and older adults?
Of course! For children, some walks require adult supervision and basic fitness. For older adults, we recommend the options that best suit their mobility. ‍‍‍ Child rate for ages 3 to 10; children under 3 pay a minimum rate without meals. At Parque del Café, the child rate applies to heights between 91 and 124 cm.

### Do you have accessible, barrier-free options?
Yes! We have adapted options and special vehicles so everyone can enjoy the region without barriers. We also have a guide for blind travellers. Ask us and we'll give you personalised advice.

### Which languages do the guides speak?
Guides in Spanish, English, French, Italian and Portuguese (guiding in a language other than Spanish costs extra). On shared tours, the English-speaking guide carries a supplement per service.

### What if I cancel?
We understand that plans change. Cancellation terms depend on how far in advance you let us know. Tell me which tour you booked and we'll review your case with an advisor.

### Are you a sustainable company?
We work with farming families, artisans and local guides, with fair pay. We give you water on every tour and a reusable rain poncho (zero single-use plastics), we separate waste and we plant trees to offset our carbon footprint. We reject the sexual exploitation of children and adolescents (ESCNNA).
